conclusion: 4-GPU DDP is technically runnable after enabling unused-parameter detection, but the PK249 pilot is not an efficient 4-GPU workload because queue/setup/upload dominate one-epoch wall time and no nvidia-smi utilization trace was captured by the deployed legacy entrypoint.

attempts.name: legacy_entrypoint_v2

operational_notes: DDP initialized with four NCCL ranks and all ranks saw CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=[0,1,2,3].
The deployed legacy Batch entrypoint did not run the new GPU monitor, so gpu_utilization.csv was not produced.
For the PK249 pipeline-validation pilot, a 1-GPU job definition remains the lower-cost default unless a direct 1-GPU comparison proves otherwise.
For the future full-cohort model, rerun a longer telemetry-enabled comparison after publishing an image that includes gpu_utilization.csv support.
